title: Written on the Wall II, Conjecture 84: tree(G) ≥ 2 rad(G) / δ(G)
abstract: A complete Lean 4 / Mathlib formalization of Conjecture 84 of DeLaViña's "Written on the Wall II" (conjectures of Graffiti.pc): for every finite simple connected graph G with positive minimum degree δ(G), the maximum number of vertices of an induced subtree satisfies tree(G) ≥ 2·rad(G)/δ(G). The formal statement is the one recorded in google-deepmind/formal-conjectures (WrittenOnTheWallII/GraphConjecture84.lean, theorem `conjecture84`), copied verbatim together with its definition of `largestInducedTreeSize`. The proof formalizes the argument of J. J. Gebendorfer's manuscript "Induced trees in graphs with a cut vertex" (28 October 2026): the case δ(G) ≥ 2 follows from a diametral geodesic, and the case δ(G) = 1 from the stronger theorem tree(G) ≥ 2·rad(G) for every connected graph with a cut vertex, proved by a minimal-counterexample reduction to a 2-connected core with pendant paths of equal positive length. Along the way the induced-tree consequence tree(H) ≥ 2·rad(H) − 1 of Chung's induced-path bound (Erdős–Saks–Sós 1986, Theorem 2.2) is proved, which is all the argument needs.
